title: Add model-catalog hints: tool-calling support, streaming-stability score, and rate/price limits
author: Aisha Patel
ci_details: unit tests: pass; integration tests (catalog+db+redis mock): pass; lint: pass; e2e streaming stability matrix: initially flaky, rerun succeeded; load tests (50 concurrent listings): pass
description: Summary: Adds per-model metadata and API filtering hints to the model catalog to help clients select models that support tool/function calling, have strong streaming stability characteristics, and expose recommended rate/price limits. Motivation: Customers building production-grade chat experiences need a single model listing that surfaces not just capabilities but operational hints (streaming robustness, function-calling fidelity, concurrency guidance, and pricing bounds) so they can safely route requests and set fallbacks without trial-and-error. This change is intended to reduce integration surprises for SDK users and make the hosted catalog more useful for Dedicated/Private routing policies. What changed (high level): 1) Catalog schema: added fields streaming_stability_score (float 0.0-1.0), streaming_profiles (list of short ids), tool_calling_compat (enum: none/partial/full), structured_output_profiles (list), recommended_concurrency (int hint), pricing_tier (string), per_token_price_usd_hint (decimal string), and region_rate_limits (map-style string encoded per-region hint). 2) List API: new query params supports_tool_calling, min_streaming_score, pricing_tier, max_per_token_price_usd and region to filter results server-side. Also added response hints in the model object to suggest default streaming configuration and recommended backoff. 3) OpenAI-compat shim: updated compatibility flags to include function_calling_policy and structured_output_profile names so the shim can map OpenAI-style function calling to our tool_calling_compat enum. 4) Docs & examples: extended model_catalog.md with new filter examples and SDK snippets (TS + Python) showing how to pick models for stable streaming and safe function calls. 5) Tests & migrations: DB migration to add columns, unit tests for filters and serialization, e2e streaming stability check in CI. Backwards compatibility: All new catalog fields are optional and default to conservative values (tool_calling_compat=none, streaming_stability_score=0.0). Clients that ignore unknown fields will continue to work. Checklist: - [x] Schema migration and defaults - [x] API changes and parameter validation - [x] SDK examples updated - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Docs updated - [x] Release notes drafted Commits (summary): - catalog: add streaming_stability_score and tool_calling_compat to model schema - api: add list-models filters and param parsing + validation - db: migration 20251112_add_catalog_hints.sql - docs: update model_catalog.md and examples - tests: add streaming filter unit tests and e2e streaming scenario Review convo (summary): - Evan: requested stronger validation on min_streaming_score and asked for examples of how scores are computed. Aisha: added score computation note to docs and clamped query param server-side. - Jia: asked to surface concurrency hint only as advisory (not enforced by routing); updated handler and docs accordingly. - Samir: flagged that per_token_price_usd_hint needs a currency string to avoid ambiguity; we switched to decimal string with USD suffix in docs and validation. CI and stability notes: The streaming e2e matrix initially produced a flaky test against the older runtime image; we reproduced locally, adjusted the test harness timing, and reran CI which passed. Load tests for listing endpoints at 50 concurrent requests passed with the new indexes. Merge and rollout plan: Merged to main via squash on 2025-11-18. Feature gate enabled by default but catalog consumers can opt out by filtering only models without the new flags. Rollout steps: - DB migration run in staging -> monitor catalog list latency and index usage for 24h - enable new query params in staging SDKs samples -> validate downstream callers - schedule a gradual rollout to canary Dedicated tenants before global rollout Breaking change? false. Rollback plan: revert migration + roll back service, or keep fields optional and disable new query parsing if immediate rollback needed. Release notes: Added advisory metadata in model catalog: streaming stability score, tool-calling compatibility flags, structured output profiles, and per-model recommended concurrency and token-price hints. This enables safer client-side model selection for streaming/function-calling workflows. Merge method: squash. Additional context: This PR is intended as an intermediate step before exposing richer streaming configuration profiles (follow-up ENG-2308) and before adding server-enforced rate limits per-model (planned feature ENG-2401).
